physical_source_generation.state_definition: 0 is normalized scale start and 1 is normalized full scale; normalized 0 need not mean physical reading 0.

cost.accounting_note: Subprocess wall times include process startup and are not GPU kernel time or CPU core time. The initial failed preparation is counted separately. End-to-end time includes the stopped interval.

limitations: This stage changes state coverage in existing source scenes; it adds no background diversity.
The result records source data integrity and execution costs, not a model generalization result.

cohort_definitions.source: Frozen common_ordinary1495, r8_ordinary1497 and old_severe_union6 flags.

limitations: Single seed, four new epochs per arm, and already viewed external development sets; no blind-test, significance or universal algorithm claim.
Source1506 selects within-run best; fixed last4 is reported separately. Local best4 and last4 are the same weights and their external results were reused.
The two native families have different prior training histories, so a cross-family comparison is context rather than an isolated normalization effect.
Backbone parameters are fixed while source BatchNorm running buffers update. This does not preserve all CNN state or restore an ImageNet-pretrained representation.
Strict tensor-load, frozen-weight and BatchNorm evidence is read from saved runtime metadata; no checkpoint tensors were loaded again during this CPU audit.

Exact 512 endpoint replacements, untouched18078 rows and C4 metadata were independently established earlier; current endpoint data contracts are compared directly to the corresponding full-fine-tuning control without repeating render GT checks.
RF100 scalar targets were derived offline from four-point annotations; inference used original ROI RGB only.
